title: Archytan Lite policy.json
description: Says, for each action, which roles may take it, and for an action with grants, on which resources. An action absent from this file is always BLOCK for every role -- there is no ambient-allow path. Archytan Lite also refuses a file with a key this schema doesn't name, a key repeated in one object, or two keys that differ only in case. See internal/policy/registry.go and the README.

$schema.description: Optional. The schema this file follows, for editors that read it.

version.description: Format version. 1 and 2 are read the same way; anything else is refused.

actions.description: Every gated action. An action name not listed here can never be ALLOWed.

action.description: The gated action's name, e.g. "device.factory_reset". Whatever your backend sends as the authorize request's "action" field -- must match exactly, with no leading or trailing whitespace.

allowed_roles.description: Roles that may take this action on any resource. An empty list is rejected outright -- omit the action from the file instead, since that already means BLOCK for everyone. A rule names its roles here or in grants, never both.

grants.description: Roles paired with the resource ids they may take this action on; any other resource is BLOCK. Read by Archytan Lite 2.7.0 and later. Earlier versions refuse a rule without allowed_roles, so they refuse the whole file rather than run it without its scope.

roles.description: Roles this grant applies to. A role named in several grants gets all of them.

resource_ids.description: Patterns matched against the request's resource.id segment by segment, by exact bytes. * matches any run of characters inside one segment; a final ** matches the name before it and everything below it. A pattern must start with a literal name. Before matching, a resource id with ., .. or empty segments, both / and \, a segment ending in a dot or starting or ending with a space, a Windows device or drive-relative name, or any character outside letters, digits, combining marks and " -_.~+=,@:#()" is refused. See the README's "Scoping an action to the resources it may touch".

assertions.description: Optional limits checked in addition to allowed_roles or grants, never instead of them. Omit entirely rather than including one that asserts nothing.

max_per_window.description: Ceiling on successful uses of this action by one caller inside window_seconds. Required together with window_seconds -- a count without a duration does not describe a rate.

window_seconds.description: The window max_per_window counts within, in seconds. Required together with max_per_window.

tenant_match.description: Require the caller's credential-bound tenant (from callers.json) to equal the request's resource.tenant_id. Only meaningful with ARCHYTAN_LITE_CALLERS_PATH set and every registered caller carrying a tenant -- see the README's "Reloading policy.json" and callers.schema.json.
